notes.title: July 29th Update Notes
notes.content:
When harvesting crops, you can now automatically pick them up. A crop icon will flash during harvesting so you no longer need to press the E key again to collect them, making harvesting more convenient.

Added the feature of auto-picking up leaves and wood dropped when cutting grass, making it easier for players to collect dropped items.

For the above two features, if your inventory is full, the dropped items will remain on the ground, and players can choose whether to pick them up.

Flares have been added in the subway station in the main city. You can use flares to burn zombies or for illumination.

Many random events involving tentacle zombies have been added to the southeast corner of the eastern district. Passersby may transform into tentacle zombies at any time.

Fixed the issue where autosaves would not display when the number of autosave files exceeded 20. This was due to an incorrect setting, which has now been corrected.

Added a black screen death prompt related to using the construction box, to prevent affecting the gameplay experience due to lack of information.

Resolved the issue where teammates would also automatically pick up crops for the protagonist when hitting crops. Constraints have now been added.

Modified the display logic for the flashing icon when auto-picking items. Unified the code for loading, optimizing memory usage.

Adjusted the probability of triggering the chicken trap to prevent the trigger time from being too fixed, making the triggering method more random and natural.

Fixed an issue in Director Mode where right-clicking to clear crops or grass would leave behind seeds, leaves, and wood drops.

The camera issue with the third mission’s street scene animation has been fixed. The camera movement has been adjusted to prevent it from going off-screen.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42699193/1a9d18fa728eb3bcf7d0ce2630467d75631ad40c.png"]

notes.title: July 19th Update Notes
notes.content:
A new type of high wall, the Stone High Wall, has been added. This wall cannot be climbed over and can block the movement of both zombies and humans.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42699193/0c07caecd3ac47314b6b9ab92106b7fd567f90c6.png"]

You need to use stones and nails to build this wall. The Stone High Wall has higher defense than the Wooden High Wall.

Stones needed for crafting the Stone High Wall can be picked up from the ground outdoors, and they will have a glowing prompt when you get close.

Several new respawn points have been added to Survival Mode, with some located in dangerous areas.

Fixed an issue where the construction description would not update when rapidly switching the mouse while the building panel was open.

Adjusted the probability of cups appearing in indoor toilets or bathrooms and increased the spawn rate of drinks on supermarket shelves.

Fixed an error in Director Mode where placing a zombie horde defense and having the protagonist approach a high wall would cause the horde to attack the wall.

Added description text for new items and their corresponding translation files.

Modified the display logic for prompts in the building panel. Previously, prompts could display abnormally on screens with unusual aspect ratios; this has now been fixed.

Optimized the display size of some construction images in the building panel, improving loading speed and reducing memory usage.

notes.title: June 27th Update Content
notes.content:
Resolved an issue where some computers would display large white squares for clouds. A new method for rendering clouds has been implemented.

Fixed a problem where dialogues could not be skipped when clicking to skip the prologue. This was caused by variables not being updated.

Added some zombie hordes and zombies to the main road in the eastern district to increase the game’s challenge and unpredictability.

notes.title: June 25th Update Notes
notes.content:
The weather system now features dynamic clouds. You can see changing cloud shadows on the ground and buildings as the clouds move.

Clouds will change over time, and extreme weather conditions such as overcast skies, heavy rain, or clear skies may occur.

In the future, cloud control functionality will be added to Director Mode, allowing you to combine it with other weather controllers to create a variety of interesting weather types.

Shadow occlusion effects have been added under trees, with shadows changing dynamically according to the weather, enhancing visual quality.

Fishing rods can now be found in the shops within the main city’s commercial area. You can use them to fish by the riverside or seaside.

Some aspects of the initial storyline involving the search for your sister have been modified, with certain animations removed and a prompt to press ‘M’ to open the map added.

A feature to skip certain story parts has been added. Now, later sections of the prologue can be skipped by pressing the ESC key.

Fixed an issue where other characters would perform a heavy attack whenever you did, which was caused by incorrectly shared variables.

Fixed an issue where only one wooden high wall blueprint would remain and could not be dismantled. This was due to a variable not being reset properly.

Adjusted the probability of finding repair kits, adrenaline, and enhancement pills when searching for supplies indoors or outdoors.

Added prompts regarding story skipping and corresponding translations, and optimized some text files to improve loading speed.

notes.title: Wooden high walls have been added！！！
notes.content:
Wooden high walls have been added! You can now use them to build more complex camps.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42699193/32ad41e278dede2cefecfc437abfd181989b0e0f.png"]

Wooden high walls are different from ordinary fences—they are much taller and have higher defense, blocking the movement of both zombies and humans. Humans cannot climb over high walls.

You can construct wooden high walls from the build panel by drawing blueprints to plan the wall’s shape, then build by placing materials.

Building wooden high walls requires wood and iron nails. Hold the middle mouse button to dismantle wooden high walls. You can also right-click to cancel blueprint drawing.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42699193/ec4961fb73786aff197f6f0fb3b2d99b15a741ec.png"]

Added a new plant: grass. This plant will be widely placed on the map in the future and, like regular shrubs, will refresh automatically.

Added explosive one-time melee weapons in the Eastern District’s underground water pipes and subway, making exploration more interesting.

Adjusted the probability for teammates to find items such as enhancement pills, adrenaline, and repair kits when searching for supplies.

Some of the weather system code has been modified to prevent excessively long periods of rain or wind, increasing weather variety.

Fixed an issue where some items were not displayed when there were insufficient items to deduct, caused by incorrect quantity code.

Added prompts and texts related to wooden high walls, with corresponding translations.

Fixed an issue where farmland might not be saved after being placed, caused by quantity data not being cleared.

Resolved an issue where teammates would use lassos as melee weapons, due to lassos not being excluded from the weapon list.

When dismantling wooden high wall blueprints, there is a chance that a white box might appear near the high wall’s location; this will automatically disappear when switching to the desktop.

Added a prompt at the start of tower defense, informing players they can choose whether to begin tower defense (based on feedback, the story mode now allows players to skip tower defense).

Added random events inside the villa building in the central area of the Eastern District, enhancing the fun of outdoor exploration.
Fixed an issue where crops on farmlands would not automatically disappear when the farmland was cleared.

notes.title: May 27th Update
notes.content:

You can now build farmlands in the construction panel, allowing you to farm on any flat terrain (even indoors) without being limited by the land. This enables you to create camps with farmland anywhere!!!

Added tower defense-related hint text and corresponding translations, and organized folder directories to improve loading speed.
Fixed the issue where fish would appear on the ground after crossing maps or reloading save points while the fish pond contained fish.

Adjusted Thirst Rate in Rain: Modified the rate at which thirst decreases in rainy weather to better reflect real-life scenarios.
Reduced Tentacle Monster Spawn: Decreased the spawn rate of Tentacle Monsters in Survival Mode to prevent them from breaking walls too frequently and disrupting tower defense balance.
Fixed Teammate Data Loss: Corrected an issue where having too many teammates would cause data storage problems when traversing the map. This was caused by an array out-of-bounds error.

notes.title: April 7th Update:
notes.content:
Added a new food item: Wheat Rice. This can be obtained by cooking wheat in a campfire. Wheat can be acquired through farming.
New random events added: Find these at the hospital entrance and the subway station. These events include new resource supplies and weapons.
Hydration from fire hydrants: You can now drink from fire hydrants by pressing the R key. This replaces the previous method of drinking directly from water sources.

Dew collectors: Added functionality to collect water using dew collectors. Included corresponding prompts and translations.
Water cup in backpack: Added a button to drink from a water cup in the backpack. Clicking the water cup icon will display the button in the bottom right corner.
Fixed hydration/fullness bug: Fixed an issue where drinking water when hydration was full but hunger wasn’t would result in wasted water consumption. This was caused by an incorrect condition.

notes.title: Major update to survival content!
notes.content:
After a period of meticulous development, we have added some new features to survival mechanics. The game characters will now have Sleep Value and Thirst Value!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42699193/ad738d3e5a7fe4337e1bbf7dbcf7b76254a1ea8f.png

About Sleep Value:

To achieve this goal, we have modified the functionality of all beds in the world, making them more than just decorative objects. The main character will experience fatigue over time, and when fatigue reaches a certain level, players will need to find a nearby location to rest. A flashing prompt will appear in the lower left corner to notify you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42699193/4c16ef0a8c1eb7ab92e852946fbcdaf313e60689.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42699193/fb17ade7c1f63db00e8c33841fff5c59e85b1cce.png

When your character is tired, you need to find a place with a bed to sleep:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42699193/ebc03eef445df6120329cc8d9d997bef466fc6de.png

Alternatively, you can craft a sleeping bag:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42699193/a98e18f5f9386919669879ee3d62010c61f6495a.png

Of course, it won’t always be that simple. You need to ensure that there are no threats nearby when you sleep. Any zombies nearby will prevent the character from sleeping. In such cases, players need to clear zombies around the house and strengthen defensive structures to create a safe environment. This change will make the game more challenging.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42699193/ed80f9464dbc6efda49fbdb3532691f931d79a53.png

About Thirst Value:

At the same time, the main character will experience thirst over time. Most consumable items in the game world will now affect the character’s thirst value, including your teammates. For balance considerations, the thirst value currently has a relatively low impact on teammates.

You can obtain water through several types of food, such as beer, mushroom soup, vegetable soup, and more:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42699193/62ed36de4e9beeb888d040fa2aef0a0ac9a1eab8.png

Or craft an empty cup to collect water near swimming pools or fire hydrants:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42699193/d47d516c69a629bef0f2b728863587a409b76d5f.png

You can also craft a water storage facility for storing water (this facility will fill up during rainy days):

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42699193/b0c7f013d5d437e662535afcc952dfdeecd3ddad.png

When the thirst value drops below a certain level, it will harm the character’s health. Players need to replenish water and store water in preparation for emergencies.

At the same time, we’ve introduced several new items that can replenish hydration, which you can find indoors/outdoors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42699193/b9a0ee57dcf15b7d5ca071e5e74b1b3e80654963.png

You can press TAB and hover your mouse over the left panel to check character status, which displays the current thirst and hunger values. Icons have been added on the far left to help you quickly locate the corresponding values.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42699193/aba1cd7129d5d9f9af4a51506626da0671f4ef80.png

In future updates, we will continue to enrich survival-related content, such as boiling water in the kitchen or the character needing to use the toilet. We may also introduce Infection Value and related features, including medicines and items to expand this gameplay mechanic.

New Food Item: “Mushroom Soup”: You can now make mushroom soup by placing mushrooms in a campfire. Mushrooms can be obtained by searching for resources.

Mushroom Soup in Searchable Items: Mushroom soup has been added to the list of searchable food items, and there is a chance to find it on shelves.

notes.title: March 27 Update Content
notes.content:
Interactive Beds: All beds are now interactive.  Press E to select the “sleep” option and have your character sleep. Sleeping will skip approximately 7 hours of game time, but will also decrease your fullness level. Ensure the surrounding area is safe and that no one else is in the bed.

New Food Item: Roasted Corn:  You can now roast corn by placing it in a campfire. Corn can be obtained through planting.

Increased Exploration Variety:  Added motors, grenades, and various events to some resource points, enhancing the randomness and fun of exploration.

Hunger Icon Update: The hunger icon in the bottom left corner has been redesigned for better clarity.

Thunderstorm Probability Adjustment: The probability of thunderstorms has been adjusted; they will now typically occur on overcast days after a long period without rain.

Resource Respawn Rate Adjustment: The respawn rate of resources in houses during exploration has been modified to encourage players to explore more.

Unclosable TV Bug Fix: The issue where TVs in some houses couldn’t be turned off has been fixed. This was caused by an inconsistency between screen refresh rate and game refresh rate.

Interactive Item Highlight Fix: The issue where the “searched” indicator would appear when the mouse hovered over an interactive item has been fixed.  Now, an E key prompt will appear.

Spacebar Jump Fix: Fixed the issue where pressing the spacebar while searching an item would cause the character to jump. This was due to a missing code constraint.

Resource Point Adjustments: Some resource points have been moved, removed, or added to make exploration more rewarding and challenging.  These points are often located in more difficult-to-reach areas.

Turret/Machine Gun Exit Prompt: Added a prompt for the exit key (bottom right) when operating a turret or machine gun and corrected the translation of the prompt.

Translation Updates: Added descriptions and translations for the new “Roasted Corn” item.  Updated the location of some translation files. Added translations related to beds, safety warnings, and occupancy warnings.  Updated the location of translation files.

Future updates will add more survival content and more roasts food items to enrich food preparation and increase the depth of survival gameplay. Stay tuned!

the Director Mode
